job.text: Look up each region's successful transactions, the small counts included

source.shows: the outlier inset: the main chart keeps its full linear scale from zero (“500 successful transactions”), the catch-all last in its reserved grey (R3-16, R9-9); the five small regions re-plotted on their own scale from zero in the largest empty area of the plot, above them and right of East, 0–20 by 5 where the book stops at 15 with a bar of 16 (no bar passes the top gridline); a frame round the small bars at the baseline, two links forming a widening cone (G2.26, G2.27, G2.29)
